lines.text: The signal is there. But are we listening at the right moment?
Two coincidences make a detection: right band, right moment. We hear only two bands at once.
A fixed sweep can lock into blindness, missing every pulse. Detection: zero.
Pushpak stops sweeping, and starts learning. Observe, estimate, decide, and learn. Every observation drives the next choice.
Search, confirm, track. Beliefs plus revisit deadlines, with anti-sync dither, so we never lock out a band.
Measured, not asserted. Bandit: zero point seven one. Index: zero point nine six seven.
Now the working product. Press run the demo, watch the waterfall stream, and see Index pull ahead, live.
Pushpak. Learning where to listen. Simulation only.
